excludedSources.title: Broad adductor claims from secondary summaries
excludedSources.reason: Not used as a visible role because local anatomy contains Adductor longus but not a broad adductor or adductor magnus entry, and the reviewed direct sources did not justify mapping a deep squat adductor role specifically to Adductor longus.

notes: Variant assumption: generic free-weight back squat, not separated into high-bar, low-bar, heel-elevated, pause, box, or powerlifting variants. Visible map is intentionally conservative. Quadriceps and Gluteus maximus are primary; Hamstrings secondary; Trunk stabilizers and Gastrocnemius support. No included visible muscle lacks a local mesh mapping.
